newsitem.title: BULGARIA: BULGARIA'S DOBREV CANCELS STOYANOV MEETING.
newsitem.headline: BULGARIA'S DOBREV CANCELS STOYANOV MEETING.

text.p: Bulgaria's ruling Socialists met for crisis talks on Friday after Interior Minister Nikolai Dobrev offered to give up trying to form a Socialist-led cabinet.
Dobrev told Reuters he had cancelled a scheduled meeting with President Petar Stoyanov, after earlier saying he planned to ask Stoyanov to appoint a coalition cabinet himself.
Dobrev said he had postponed the meeting to give Socialist leader Georgi Parvanov time for further talks with other political parties.
"The consultations are expected to end tomorrow evening. After that, the ruling bodies of the coalition should be gathered," Dobrev told Reuters.

Parvanov said after meeting the party leadership that preparations for a new cabinet were going according to plan, but opposition leader Ivan Kostov said Dobrev's apparent climbdown showed he was having trouble finding anyone to join him.
Under the constitution, Dobrev has until Tuesday to form a cabinet. Opponents of the divided ruling party have held 26 days of mass protests to demand immediate elections.
